verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an AI accelerator platform, since accelerator vendors commonly ship management and tooling CLIs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions an official Gaudi CLI. The docs cover Docker images, PyTorch, DeepSpeed, vLLM and SGLang workflows, plus vague 'purpose-built software tools' for migration. None of this documents a first-party command-line tool for AI-native use.
